title: GenesisSeed v0.1
description: The reusable FORMATION artifact of the Open Agent Continuum (ADR-0001): a signed, typed operating charter that Inception binds into a live twin. Genesis is compile-time and reusable; Inception is runtime and contextual. A seed is NOT a free-form prompt — it declares role archetype, ontology slice, allowed organs, and the retrieval/memory/policy/provider/federation/approval profiles a twin may operate within. Consume-not-fork: a seed's organs_allowed/provider_profile INSTANTIATE into a WorkspaceMountTable (schemas/workspace-mount-table.schema.json, f*); its policy_profile is served by Sentinel; its provenance memory is the ProofArtifact spine (tools/proof-artifact-spine, f_!); its epistemic ceiling is computed by tools/workspace-controller. Grounded in the inception spec (2026-03-09) Genesis/Inception/K3 sections and the estate's receipt/epistemic laws.
$comment: Cross-field rules enforced by tools/validate_genesis_seed.py (not expressible in pure JSON Schema): (1) memory_profile.provenance MUST be append_only [also pinned by the schema const below — checked both ways]; (2) if provider_profile contains any mutating/host provider (provider:kubernetes | provider:host | *host_update*), approval_profile.host_mutation MUST be 'required' — fail-closed actuation (spec non-negotiable #1, ADR actuation gate).

seed_id.description: Stable unique identifier and version, e.g. seed:operator/deploy-v1. A seed is a versioned artifact (changes require provenance).

archetype.description: Role archetype: research_twin | operator_twin | auditor_twin | deployment_twin | synthesis_twin | ...

ontology_slice.description: Subset of the canonical ontology visible to the twin by default (the mounted cover, S1).

goal_schema.description: Reference to the expected intent + success-criteria schema this seed's twins accept.

organs_allowed.description: Permitted capability modules / tool classes (retriever, planner, verifier, tool_exec, policy_check, workflow, ...). This is the twin's capability envelope — it instantiates into a mount table.

retrieval_profile.description: Which retrieval families (organs/operating modes) the twin may select — NOT mutually exclusive whole-system categories.

memory_profile.description: Read/write posture per memory stratum. Provenance memory is APPEND-ONLY by law (spec 7.4 + AC-1): a later correction references, never erases, the earlier state.

provenance.description: MUST be append_only — provenance is never rewritten (enforced here AND in tools/validate_genesis_seed.py).

policy_profile.description: Required policy modules (safety/data-access/delegation/actuation/regional/review) served by Sentinel/OPA, e.g. policy:deploy/base, policy:human_gate/high_risk.

provider_profile.description: External service bindings the twin may use, e.g. provider:kubernetes, provider:artifact_store. A mutating/host provider forces approval_profile.host_mutation == required (fail-closed actuation).

federation_profile.description: Whether/how peer twins may cooperate. A seed cannot self-declare unbounded federation — start same-domain only (ADR federation gate).

approval_profile.description: What requires human review/co-signature, keyed by action kind, e.g. {"host_mutation": "required"}.
